[ASSISTANT_SAID] "Pride and Joy" by Stevie Ray Vaughan is a blues classic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Simplified chord progression for "Pride and Joy":  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Verse: C - G - Am - F, C - G - F - C  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Chorus: G - Am - F - C, G - F - C  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Chord Shapes: C: 032010, G: 320003, Am: x02210, F: 133211  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips: Focus on playing clean, crisp chords with a strong rhythm; use a steady, driving strumming pattern; pay attention to chord changes, especially between Am and F; experiment with vibrato and string bending.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Once comfortable with the chord progression, user can start working on the "Pride and Joy" riff based on a 12-bar blues pattern.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can find many online resources that provide tablature or video lessons to help learn the riff.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reminder: Practice makes perfect! Start slow and gradually increase speed.
